no_impact_reason.description: Why the PR needs no doc change; empty when proposals is non-empty.

doc_path.description: Repo-relative path, under docs/, of the doc this proposal changes or creates.

section.description: Heading of the section to replace, or empty to create a new doc.

file.description: Path of the changed file the anchor points into.

line.description: Head-side, 1-based line number within the changed file.

anchor.description: Line in the PR diff that caused this proposal.

reason.description: One-line explanation of why this doc change is needed.

content.description: Full replacement for the section including its heading line, or the full content of a new doc.

index_entry.description: Entry to add to the docs index; set iff section is empty.

proposals.description: Doc changes the PR needs; empty when the PR has no doc impact.
